title: Length under list flattening
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be types, let $f$ assign to each $a\in A$ a list over $B$ of length at least $1$, and let $l$ be any finite list over $A$. Then the length of $l$ is at most the length of the concatenation of the lists $f(a)$ as $a$ ranges through $l$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $a\in A$, the list $f(a)$ has length at least $1$
replaced: Let $A$ and $B$ be types and let $f$ map every $a \in A$ to a list $f(a)$ over $B$ of length at least $1$. Then for every list $(a_1,\dots,a_k)$ over $A$, the concatenation $f(a_1)\,f(a_2) \cdots f(a_k)$ has length at least $k$.
